disposition_rationale: RECLASSIFY_TO_EXCLUDED under Plans/Decision_Log.md#DL-407 (E-CARDS-1 2c A): memory.gist.verification_requested. Verification request retains only its command result and creates zero history events. AMS-130 supplies the complete surviving semantic contract, CV-785 identity/replay/withdrawal, SP-765 custody, ATS-380 oracles. This is an exclusion, not event admission or contract-depth credit. Prior DCN row-local application is retained; the parent union has not yet merged it.
